messages:
samir: hey team - noticing a small but consistent tail latency bump and occasional output-mismatch for pelican-quant-v7 after runtime 7.4.1 unpin + allocator change. p99 up ~80ms in us-east, mismatch ~0.15%. any immediate routing/pin activity?

deploybot: Deploybot: observed anomaly for model=pelican-quant-v7 region=us-east at 05:10 UTC. Auto-redirected 2% traffic -> pelican-quant-v6 for mitigation. No active pin. (bot)

sre_alan: logs show allocator warnings right before mismatch: ```WARN cuda_allocator: deferred_free returned stale ptr 0x7f3a2b0000 at allocator.cc:218```

maria: can repro with a stress loop hitting streaming + long prompts. repro: `./stress_stream --model pelican-quant-v7 --turns 30 --parallel 8 --runtime 7.4.1` -> intermittent decode-mismatch. attaching trace in ticket.

runtime_pm: runtime 7.4.1 included the deferred-free refactor to reduce fragmentation. it changes free timing which could expose reuse races when combined with SDK streaming buffer changes.

sdk_kate: SDK 9.0 introduced aggressive stream buffering flush to improve throughput. we noted it can surface allocator timing issues; we added a compatibility flag `STREAM_FLUSH_LEGACY=true` but it's off by default.

samir: proposal: soft-pin runtime 7.3.9 for pelican-quant-v7 in us-east + eu-west for 2h while runtime + sdk teams triage. keep 5% canary on 7.4.1. avoids global revert.

release_czar: approved for 2h. rollback criteria: if mismatch_rate >0.3% sustained for 10m -> escalate to full pin; if p99 latency increases >120ms after pin -> immediate rollback to 7.4.1 and open incident. owners: runtime-team + sdk-team + infra-sre.

deploybot: executing pin: `/deploybot pin-runtime --model pelican-quant-v7 --runtime 7.3.9 --regions us-east-1,eu-west-1 --duration 2h --canary 5% --note "allocator timing mismatch"`

deploybot: Pin applied at 8422223360 :white_check_mark:

opsbot: Note: soft-pin executed. 5% canary preserved to 7.4.1 for monitoring. Automated follow-up scheduled at pin expiry. (bot)

maria: started the regression harness against both runtimes. preliminary: mismatch rate dropped to 0.02% in us-east within 4m, p99 back to baseline. posting heatmap shortly.

sre_alan: running memory and tail traces. initial observation: allocator warnings stop after pin. will upload snippets to ticket.

sdk_kate: will enable `STREAM_FLUSH_LEGACY=true` for pinned model routes and open a micro-patch to add safer buffer fences. PR link when ready.

samir: release note draft: "Applied temporary runtime pin to 7.3.9 for pelican-quant-v7 in us-east-1 & eu-west-1 to mitigate allocator/timing-induced output mismatches observed after runtime 7.4.1 unpin. 2h soft-pin; 5% canary retained. Owners: Runtime, SDK & Infra-SRE."

release_czar: staying on this thread. if green at +1h consider lifting early; otherwise follow rollback/escalation plan. opsbot will post a summary at pin-lift or expiry.
